### Recommended Topic Tags

| Topic | Why |
|-------|-----|
| `photography` | Core subject of the project |
| `portfolio` | It's a photography portfolio site |
| `web-development` | Web-based project |
| `pug` | HTML templating engine used |
| `sass` | CSS preprocessor used |
| `gulp` | Build system |
| `creative-studio` | Describes the brand type |
| `photography-portfolio` | Specific niche |
| `fashion` | One of the key categories |
| `responsive-design` | Mobile-friendly site |
| `javascript` | Client-side logic |
| `build-tools` | Gulp-based pipeline |
